name: xule-site
description: Personal website - book aesthetic, algorithmic age

scripts.build: bun run build:site && bun run verify
scripts.build:site: bun scripts/gen-og-cards.mjs && bun scripts/sync-image-cache.mjs restore && rm -rf _site && eleventy && bun scripts/sync-image-cache.mjs save && bunx pagefind --site _site && bun scripts/build-freshness.mjs --write
scripts.verify: bun run freshness:check && bun run og:lint && bun run renderings:lint && bun run built-json:lint && bun run artifact:test && bun run play:test && bun run sitemap:test && bun run sitemap:lint && bun run pipeline:test && bun run surface:test
scripts.test:making: bun run freshness:check && playwright test tests/making
scripts.test:runtime: bun run freshness:check && playwright test tests/runtime --project=desktop --project=mobile-boundary
scripts.test:ui: bun run freshness:check && playwright test tests/reading tests/fonts --project=desktop && playwright test tests/modals --project=desktop --project=phone --project=phone-narrow && playwright test tests/discovery --project=phone --project=desktop
